'''Remsh''' was the sixth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbiting the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Iminec]] in the [[Kalee system/Legends|Kalee system]]. It was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]], located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].
